memberdef.name: CUDA_CHECK
memberdef.initializer: do { \ cudaError_t err = (call); \ if (err != cudaSuccess) { \ throw ::themis::gpu::CudaError( \ #call, \ err, \ __FILE__, \ __LINE__ \ ); \ } \ } while(0)

briefdescription.para: RAII wrappers, error handling macros, and fail-closed patterns for GPU operations.

detaileddescription.para:
1.0.0
2026-08-16
Wave A-8 GPU hardening: implements fail-closed error handling, resource lifecycle guarantees (RAII), and kernel timeout enforcement with automatic CPU fallback.
All CUDA operations use CUDA_CHECK or explicit error handling to prevent unchecked CUDA call exposure (Phase C target: reduce 340 → 170 calls).
